welcome_text: Create a project or open one to start.
flows_none: This project has no flows yet.
canvas_empty: Add a node from the list to start this flow.
notice_migrated: This project was written in format version {version}. It is saved in the current format.
notice_unsaved: Save your changes before you open another project.
error_backend: The app could not complete that action.
error_catalog: The list of nodes could not be loaded.
panel_hint: Select a node to edit it.
panel_hint_many: Select a single node to edit it.
alias_invalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit, up to 64.
alias_taken: Another node of this flow has that alias.
field_ephemeral: Only the person who used it sees the reply
notice_rename_left: Some fields kept the old alias, because they could not be rewritten: {fields}
condition_empty: No tests yet. A branch with no condition cannot run.
condition_no_names: There is nothing to test yet at this node.
condition_not_readable: This expression has a shape the builder cannot show. Edit it as text.
condition_cannot_write: The condition cannot be written yet: {reason}
condition_row_missing: This test reads something that does not exist at this node.
condition_kind_compare: Kind of value to compare with {number}
run_exit_configuration: Configuration problem (exit code {code}); see the log
run_exit_killed: Stopped (it did not finish in time and was killed)
run_disabled_no_project: Open or create a project first.
run_disabled_errors: Fix the errors of the project first.
run_notice_invalid: The project has {count} errors; fix them to run it.
notice_running: Stop the bot before you open another project.
token_help: The token is kept in the .env file of the project folder, readable only by you, and the .gitignore of the project leaves it out. It is never shown again.
dev_help: Commands are created only on this server, so they appear at once while you test. Leave it empty for global commands.
export_help: A plain file name. The folder will hold the program, an assets folder and a .env.example.
export_done: Exported to {path}. Copy .env.example to .env and write the token there, or run the bot once from the app. The export does not start the bot.
export_invalid: The project has {count} errors; nothing was exported.
log_empty: Nothing yet. Run the bot to see its log here.
